newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher led by Ericsson/Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher led by Ericsson/Astra.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse closed higher on Thursday after blue-chips Ericsson and Astra posted gains.
The bourse's general index rose 0.39 percent to 1,992.80 after turnover of 2.8 billion crowns.
Brokers said nerves were high ahead of Friday's U.S. August jobs data due at 1230 GMT.

"U.S. debt yields are at levels like last summer when worry about a collapse was worst. If debt yields rise a few points after tomorrow's statistics it is not improbable that we would see a sharp drop on Wall Street," a broker said.
Telecoms group Ericsson rose 3.50 crowns to 157 crowns.
"Ericsson feels strong and if the U.S. figures tomorrow aren't terrible it could continue to climb," one broker said.
Drug company Astra was traded higher in the final hour of trade and the share closed up two crowns at 277.50, following the U.S. pharmaceuticals sector higher.
"Because of concern ahead of tomorrow's statistics, many chose to go into safer paper in the U.S. and especially drug shares," one broker said.
Forestry shares recovered somewhat after recent losses, the sector edging up 0.37 percent.
